key_points: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opening nearing Avengers: Endgame record indicates strong box office momentum.
Disney licensing major movie and show franchises to Netflix could generate incremental revenue but may dilute exclusive content advantage.
Barron's argues Disney and Netflix are better positioned post Paramount-Warner merger, suggesting relative strength.
CEO Josh D'Amaro expressed dissatisfaction with stock price but affirmed confidence in IP, scale, and fan base.
Analysts note recent earnings expectations trimmed but see upside potential ahead of upcoming results.
